_help: Master index for the Ministry Outreach cards on news.html. Each entry points to a folder under assets/images/ministry-outreach/{folder}/ that contains an images.json manifest. Add new events by (1) creating a new folder, (2) dropping photos/videos + an images.json manifest inside it, and (3) appending a new entry to the 'events' list below. See admin-help.html for the full walkthrough. Keep 'events' ordered most-recent-first.

events.title: Slavic Christian Awakening Evangelism
events.body: Partnered with Slavic Christian Awakening Church for a day of open-air evangelism in the heart of Bellevue Square Park. Conversations, prayer, and pocket Bibles shared with passersby.

events.title: Fishers of Men — UW Seattle
events.body: A day on the UW campus with the Fishers of Men team — student conversations, pocket Gideon NTs handed out, and prayers over the next generation walking those halls.
